page_title: PAR 2-0 LOR | Paris FC v Lorient 03/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+5' The corner is swung in but Lorient can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+5' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Obed Nkambadio to dive and make a save.
90+4' Samir Chergui (Paris FC) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
90+3' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) is given a yellow card.
90+2' The referee signals a substitution. Julien Lopez (Paris FC) is brought on as a substitute for Ilan Kebbal.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' 2:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.

87' What a big chance! Nhoa Sangui (Paris FC) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
85' Moses Simon goes off the pitch and Nhoa Sangui (Paris FC) comes on.

84' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
84' The referee signals a corner kick to Lorient.

83' Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag and Lorient will take a corner.
83' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
81' Excellent touch by Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.
79' Olivier Pantaloni prepares a substitution. Abdoulaye Faye is replaced by Bamba Dieng (Lorient).
79' Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.
78' Lorient seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) is coming onto the pitch as Arsene Kouassi cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' Olivier Pantaloni has decided to substitute Jean-Victor Makengo and he is replaced by Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient).
73' Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
71' Lorient fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
68' Here comes a substitution. Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) is brought on as a substitute for Adama Camara.
68' Stephane Gilli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Samir Chergui (Paris FC) replacing Hamari Traore.
68' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jean-Philippe Krasso as he is replaced by Jonathan Ikone (Paris FC).
68' Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
64' Half-chance! Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) plays a pass into the box, but Yvon Mvogo reacts well to snuff out the attack.
60' Here is a change. Mohamed Bamba is going off and Olivier Pantaloni gives the last tactical orders to Sambou Soumano (Lorient).
60' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) will replace Pablo Pagis.
60' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
57' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
55' Wonderful movement by Paris FC. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
54' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
52' Abdoulaye Faye (Lorient) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
52' A sweet pass inside the box gives Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
47' Benoit Millot blows his whistle as Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
45+1' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' The Paris FC players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
43' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Paris FC will have a goal kick.
42' Fouls committed – 5:2.
42' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) is caught offside!
41' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
37' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
36' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) takes the corner.

36' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Obed Nkambadio, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. Lorient have been awarded a corner kick.
35' Paris FC are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
30' 2 - 0 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) unleashes a shot straight inside the left post. Good team effort!
29' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
28' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) is penalised for a foul. Benoit Millot had a clear view and blows his whistle.
27' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 5:0.

25' 1 - 0 Goal! Jean-Philippe Krasso displays great vision and sends a pass to Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
23' Moses Simon (Paris FC) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

17' Paris FC slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
13' A long pass, executed by Arsene Kouassi (Lorient), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
11' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC).
11' Moses Simon (Paris FC) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Paris FC.
9' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
7' Lorient show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
5' The goal by Paris FC is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
4' The Paris FC players halt their celebrations as referee Benoit Millot makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
4' Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box. The ball goes inside the right post and past the goalkeeper.
2' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) dribbles into the box, but Yvon Mvogo is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
2' Bamo Meite (Lorient) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is out of play. Paris FC will have a throw-in.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Lorient will kick the game off.
Benoit Millot will supervise the game today.
